motivation: The wall family proves unbounded mim-width of I_sigma is compatible with a locally trivial exact semantic interface.
Therefore raw incidence width is not an adequate hardness proxy for the L2 repair.
The correct next object is the exact message each residual Y0 component exports to survivor-side color decisions.

message_object.component: C is a connected residual component of final G[Y0].
message_object.outside_uniformity: Every relevant outside vertex is complete or anticomplete to C under the frozen component-uniformity/source axioms.
message_object.mask: F(C) subseteq {1,2,3,4} is the set of actual colors appearing on complete outside neighbors relevant to the repair.
message_object.message: mu_C(F)=1 iff C has a proper coloring compatible with the frozen source/internal constraints when every color in F is forbidden throughout C.
message_object.warning: Finite mask alphabet does not imply the message is cheap to compute or that a family of messages is easy to compose.

primary_question: Can source-valid arbitrary-N hard C11/L2 states realize arbitrarily many nontrivial, proof-distinct component messages whose joint constraints genuinely couple survivor color choices?
killer_family_requirements: exact source-valid ancestry through the frozen Q/Lemma10/seed-two lineage
post-seed-two hard state with axiom (vi) still false
at least one residual component message non-tautological on reachable masks
components not removable by LOCAL_FULL_LIST_EXTENSION_PEEL or another exact local reconstruction rule
not already captured by an existing sealed CUT_SUPPORT / two-relation / join-tree / separator / guarded-elimination carrier scope
genuine coupling: changing survivor color decisions changes which combinations of component messages are simultaneously satisfiable
proof-distinct state growth must be demonstrated; raw multiplicity alone is insufficient
first_source_audits: Classify residual Y0 component sizes/structure allowed by post-seed-two source grammar.
Exploit that residual Y0 vertices are anticomplete to the current seed and thus retain full source list [4], unless a later source operation changes that status.
For each component class, determine which F masks are actually reachable from complete outside neighbors.
Test whether mu_C(F) reduces to ordinary k-colorability of C for k=4-|F| in the exact source state.
Import existing P7-free List-3-Coloring only where |F|>=1; do not assume the F=empty / four-color case is easy.
Search repository first for previously sealed component-deletion or message-like theorems before creating new machinery.

terminals.PASS_POLYNOMIAL_COMPONENT_MESSAGE_LANGUA: All reachable component messages and their joint interaction admit a polynomial exact representation/reconstruction under the source contract.
terminals.FAIL_SOURCE_VALID_MESSAGE_EXPLOSION: An arbitrary-N exact source-valid family forces superpolynomially many proof-distinct joint message states under the frozen downstream contract.
terminals.ROUTE_TO_EXISTING_CARRIER: The message system fits an already sealed exact carrier scope; reuse it.
terminals.OPEN_COMPONENT_MESSAGE_LANGUAGE: Neither compression nor a lower-bound/counterfamily is proved.

anti_duplication: Do not use mim-width growth by itself as a FAIL witness.
Do not count 16^(#components) raw masks unless downstream adequacy proves those coordinates are independently queryable.
Do not reimplement semijoin, separator, factorization, or guarded elimination.
Do not infer exact quotient from equal component messages without downstream adequacy/reconstruction proof.
Do not claim general polynomiality from the 16-mask alphabet.
